wf_bank_rec.name: Bank Statement-to-Ledger Reconciliation & Journal Prep
wf_bank_rec.description: End-to-end bank statement parsing, continuity audit, ledger comparison, rule-based head suggestions, and draft double-entry journals.

steps.name: File Validation & Format Check
steps.description: Validate bank statement and ledger structures

steps.name: Transaction Extraction & Normalization
steps.description: Extract deposits, withdrawals, dates, and calculate balance continuity

steps.name: Running Balance Continuity Audit
steps.description: Verify mathematical integrity of bank running balances

steps.name: Ledger Matching Engine
steps.description: Match statement against ledger entries with configurable tolerances

steps.name: Account Head & Draft Journal Generation
steps.description: Suggest account heads and draft double-entry vouchers for unmatched items

steps.name: BRS Workbook & Audit Export
steps.description: Export multi-sheet BRS reconciliation and journal registers

wf_invoice_proc.name: Bulk Invoice-to-Excel & Duplicate Auditor
wf_invoice_proc.description: Batch invoice extraction, statutory arithmetic verification, customer GSTIN/POS extraction, duplicate detection, and register generation.

steps.name: Invoice Ingestion & Format Check
steps.description: Verify file types and readability

steps.name: Tax & Line-Item Extraction
steps.description: Extract supplier, customer, GSTIN, taxable amount, taxes, cess

steps.name: Statutory Arithmetic Verification
steps.description: Audit Taxable + CGST + SGST + IGST + Cess == Total

steps.name: Batch Duplicate Detection
steps.description: Identify duplicate invoices by GSTIN, number, and value

steps.name: Consolidated Register & Exceptions Export
steps.description: Export 4-sheet formatted Excel invoice register

wf_gst_rec.name: GST Purchase Register vs GSTR-2B Reconciliation
wf_gst_rec.description: Multi-stream invoice comparison, alphanumeric normalization, Section 16(2)(aa) compliance notice, and difference reporting.

steps.name: Validate Purchase Register & 2B Data
steps.description: Check portal export and books register headers

steps.name: Normalize Invoice Numbers & GSTINs
steps.description: Strip punctuation, spaces, and leading zeros for fuzzy matching

steps.name: Multi-Level Matching Engine
steps.description: Identify exact matches, tax mismatches, missing in 2B, and missing in books

steps.name: Section 16(2)(aa) Risk Classification
steps.description: Segregate eligible vs at-risk ITC and formulate vendor follow-up actions

steps.name: Reconciliation Workbook Export
steps.description: Generate 6-sheet reconciliation register

wf_tb_audit.name: Trial Balance-to-Schedule III & Audit Scrutiny
wf_tb_audit.description: Trial balance balance verification, Companies Act Schedule III statement preparation, abnormal balance audit, and adjustments recalculation.

steps.name: Trial Balance Ingestion & Balance Check
steps.description: Verify equality of debits and credits

steps.name: Schedule III Group Classification
steps.description: Map accounts to PPE, Inventory, Receivables, Payables, Revenue, Costs

steps.name: Abnormal Balances & Scrutiny Rules
steps.description: Flag negative cash, credit debtors, debit creditors, Section 40A(3) violations

steps.name: Dynamic Audit Adjustment Processing
steps.description: Apply approved closing stock, depreciation, and accrual adjustments

steps.name: Draft Financial Statements Export
steps.description: Export 5-sheet financial statements and audit exceptions log
